sub_sector.value: clay-based cat litter and sorbent minerals; fluids purification; animal health

manufacturing_type.detail: Mines clay minerals and processes them (drying, sizing, granulating) in plants; pilot plant simulates production

production_model.detail: Packaged litter and absorbents produced for retail and distributor inventory, including private label

product_complexity.detail: Mostly clay-based sorbents like litter and floor absorbents; some specialty adsorbents and feed additives

production_role.detail: Vertically integrated miner and processor of sorbent minerals; sells finished consumer products and industrial ingredients

end_market_exposure.detail: Pet care (cat litter), animal health, fluids purification, agriculture, turf, industrial and automotive sorbents, renewable diesel

notes: Make-to-stock inferred from retail and private label packaged goods; not explicitly stated.
